parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['meeting_title','meeting_purpose','attendees','duration_minutes'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const duration=parseInt(body.duration_minutes);if(isNaN(duration)||duration<5)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'duration_minutes must be at least 5'}}];const attendees=Array.isArray(body.attendees)?body.attendees:body.attendees.split(',').map(a=>a.trim()).filter(Boolean);const meetingTypes=['status_update','decision_making','brainstorm','planning','retrospective','one_on_one','client_meeting','board_meeting','kickoff','all_hands'];const meetingType=meetingTypes.includes(body.meeting_type)?body.meeting_type:'status_update';return[{json:{valid:true,meetingTitle:body.meeting_title.trim(),meetingPurpose:body.meeting_purpose.trim().slice(0,500),meetingType,attendees,durationMinutes:duration,topicsToCover:Array.isArray(body.topics_to_cover)?body.topics_to_cover:(body.topics_to_cover||'').split('\n').map(t=>t.trim()).filter(Boolean),priorMeetingNotes:(body.prior_meeting_notes||'').slice(0,1500),decisionsNeeded:Array.isArray(body.decisions_needed)?body.decisions_needed:(body.decisions_needed||'').split('\n').map(d=>d.trim()).filter(Boolean),meetingDate:body.meeting_date||'',organizerName:body.organizer_name||'',replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You build meeting agendas that make meetings worth attending. Good agendas allocate realistic time per topic, sequence items logically (decisions before related discussion, easy wins before hard topics), state the desired outcome for each item (not just the topic), and prevent scope creep. You know that a meeting with no defined outcomes per item produces a meeting with no decisions. Always respond in valid JSON only.
